title: QBasic Gorillas
tagline: Two gorillas, one skyline, exploding bananas.
description: GORILLAS.BAS of 1991, ported statement by statement to Rust on an emulated VGA card and PC speaker, checked pixel for pixel against QBasic. Native and in the browser.

cover.alt: A city skyline of red, grey and teal tower blocks under a blue sky and a smiling sun; a gorilla stands on a rooftop at each side, a banana in flight between them.
